{{Quote|One fire, spaceport shutdown, hauler theft, four troopers knocked unconscious&hellip;they could sue us for so much. Let’s not get caught.|Myri Antilles|<ref name="MK" />}}
The '''Army hauler hijack''' was a covert operation conducted<ref name="MK" /> in [[44 ABY]]<ref name="TERC" /> by [[Wraith Squadron]], a disbanded [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Commando/Legends|commando]] unit that had recently been unofficially reformed by its former leader, [[Garik Loran]]. After arriving on the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], Loran and [[Voort saBinring]], a former Wraith whom Loran had convinced to come out of retirement, were at the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] when [[Myri Antilles]], [[Wraith Three]], deliberately bumped into Loran and slipped him a [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]] set to ignite after three minutes, which he placed inside one of their bags as part of their operation. Loran then instructed saBinring to follow Antilles to receive his next set of orders.<ref name="MK" />

They boarded a decrepit looking [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] piloted by [[Trey Courser]], [[Wraith Four]]. After landing beside a low [[Permacrete/Legends|permacrete]] wall, Antilles, pretending to be a frightened civilian, staged an argument with saBinring, who made wild motions with his arms to sell the act, while Callum concealed himself beneath a [[Blanket/Legends|blanket]] inside the speeder. Believing Antilles to be in danger, a passing [[Galactic Alliance Army]] hauler-speeder landed behind them, and its crew of four GA troopers disembarked to intervene. The [[Unidentified Army hauler pilot|pilot]] led the group towards the Wraiths as Antilles ran past to stand behind him in mock fright, where one of the [[Unidentified Galactic Alliance trooper (Myri Antilles victim)|troopers]] draped his arms around her in a gesture of comfort. Antilles quickly elbowed him in the chest, freeing her from his grasp, and signaled saBinring to drop to the ground. As he did, Courser fired from his [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]], stunning the pilot and the [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Unidentified female Galactic Alliance trooper|trooper]], while Antilles shot the trooper beside her with a [[Hold-out blaster/Legends|hold-out blaster]]. The remaining [[Unidentified male Galactic Alliance trooper|trooper]] tried to retreat into their hauler but was promptly stunned by Courser.<ref name="MK" />

The Wraiths commandeered the military hauler, with saBinring now acting as pilot while Courser worked to remove the military transponder installed on the vehicle. By then, their original speeder had become engulfed in [[Color/Legends|black]] smoke after the [[Smoke grenade/Legends|smoke grenade]] they left inside detonated. This, along with the fire at the spaceport caused by the overheating datapad, served as distractions while the Wraiths made their escape. Antilles then directed saBinring to their [[Unsafe house|safe house]], where the rest of the team were waiting.<ref name="MK" />
